capabilities: Record a screen, a window or a drawn region
Mix microphone and system audio into one track
Save recordings as MP4, WebM or MP3 in a vault folder
Embed the finished file at the cursor
Recover an interrupted recording on next start
disambiguation: Not a tool for sorting or organising captures; it records the screen and saves the video into the vault.
extras: Desktop only, no mobile. Cursor-free recording needs a separate helper binary downloaded from the project's GitHub releases; the README states recordings never leave the vault. Windows and Linux helpers are built in CI but not tested by hand.
problem: Obsidian cannot capture a screen or system audio, so recordings have to be made in another app and then imported into the vault by hand.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin, run BRAT: Add a beta plugin for testing

summary: Desktop screen recorder that captures a screen, window or region with mic and system audio and embeds the saved video in the current note.
